name: A Troubling Breeze
summary: Athridas Bearmantle waits for word from Starbreeze Village, but the reports have stopped. Great Warden Gaerolas Talvethren watches over the sleeping Druids of the Talon in the Ban'ethil Barrow Den, and his silence points to danger in Teldrassil.

sections.title: A Silent Watcher
sections.body: Athridas Bearmantle depends on regular word from Gaerolas Talvethren, the Great Warden watching over the Druids of the Talon in the Ban'ethil Barrow Den. The druids sleep there to keep their sacred pact with Ysera in the Emerald Dream. Their sanctuary matters to the spiritual balance of the young World Tree. Now reports from the east have ceased, and unease spreads through the forest.

sections.title: Unease in Starbreeze
sections.body: You are sent east across Teldrassil to Starbreeze Village to find Gaerolas. The silence is no simple oversight: corruption stirs, and wildlife grows agitated in the wilderness. When you reach him, you learn that trouble has come to the village and threatens the nearby barrow dens.

faq.answer: Athridas Bearmantle is a prominent night elf overseer in Teldrassil who watches over the forest and keeps the sanctuaries of his sleeping druidic kin undisturbed.
Gaerolas Talvethren is the Great Warden chosen to guard the sleeping Druids of the Talon in the nearby Ban'ethil Barrow Den while their spirits wander the Emerald Dream.

faq.q: What is the Ban'ethil Barrow Den?
faq.answer: The Ban'ethil Barrow Den is a sacred underground hollow on Teldrassil where night elf druids sleep for long periods to commune with Ysera and honor their pacts in the Emerald Dream.

faq.q: Why was Gaerolas out of contact?
faq.answer: Gaerolas could not send his regular reports because danger and corruption threatened Starbreeze Village and the surrounding forest, leaving him struggling to keep control.

faq.q: Where does this quest lead next?
aliases: what comes after a troubling breeze
faq.answer: After you find Gaerolas Talvethren in Starbreeze Village, he sends you back to Athridas Bearmantle in Dolanaar with grave news: the nearby Gnarlpine furbolgs have succumbed to a spreading, unnatural corruption.

faq.q: What is the pact with Ysera mentioned in the quest?
faq.answer: Night elf druids enter long meditative slumbers to walk the Emerald Dream alongside the Green Dragonflight and Ysera. They serve as custodians of nature's pristine blueprint.

angles.text: As a night elf, guarding the Druids of the Talon's sacred rest helps protect the delicate balance of your new home on Teldrassil.
As a druid, you hold the Ban'ethil Barrow Den and its sleepers bound to Ysera in deep reverence. Any disturbance to their wardens is urgent.
